[[Named item sets#Conduit of the Titans|Conduit of the Titans]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Conduit of the Titans|Conduit of the Titans]]:''' While wearing two pieces from the Conduit of the Titans set, you gain:
  • +3 Artifact bonus to Rune Arm DCs
  • +6% Artifact bonus to Electric, Repair, and Force Spell Critical Chance
  • +30 Artifact bonus to Electric, Repair, and Force Spell Power
